### Combobox

<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {

### ComboboxList

<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {
    "name": "forceMount",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when\ncontrolling animation with Vue animation libraries.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "position",
    "type": "\"popper\" | \"inline\"",
    "default": "\"popper\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The positioning mode to use, &amp;lt;br&amp;gt;\n<code>inline</code> is the default and you can control the position using CSS. &amp;lt;br&amp;gt;\n<code>popper</code> positions content in the same way as our other primitives, for example <code>Popover</code> or <code>DropdownMenu</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "bodyLock",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The document.body will be lock, and scrolling will be disabled.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "hideWhenEmpty",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, hides the content when there are no items matching the filter.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "memoDependencies",
    "type": "unknown[]",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Reactive dependencies that should invalidate the memoized content subtree.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "side",
    "type": "\"top\" | \"right\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\"",
    "default": "\"bottom\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The preferred side of the trigger to render against when open.\nWill be reversed when collisions occur and avoidCollisions\nis enabled.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "sideOffset",
    "type": "number",
    "default": "4",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The distance in pixels from the trigger.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "sideFlip",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "true",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Flip to the opposite side when colliding with boundary.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "align",
    "type": "\"center\" | \"start\" | \"end\"",
    "default": "\"center\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The preferred alignment against the trigger.\nMay change when collisions occur.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "alignOffset",
    "type": "number",
    "default": "0",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>An offset in pixels from the <code>start</code> or <code>end</code> alignment options.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "alignFlip",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "true",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Flip alignment when colliding with boundary.\nMay only occur when <code>prioritizePosition</code> is true.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "avoidCollisions",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "true",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, overrides the side and align preferences\nto prevent collisions with boundary edges.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "collisionBoundary",
    "type": "Element | (Element | null)[] | null",
    "default": "[]",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The element used as the collision boundary. By default\nthis is the viewport, though you can provide additional\nelement(s) to be included in this check.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "collisionPadding",
    "type": "number | Partial<Record<\"top\" | \"right\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\", number>>",
    "default": "0",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The distance in pixels from the boundary edges where collision\ndetection should occur. Accepts a number (same for all sides),\nor a partial padding object, for example: { top: 20, left: 20 }.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "arrowPadding",
    "type": "number",
    "default": "0",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The padding between the arrow and the edges of the content.\nIf your content has border-radius, this will prevent it from\noverflowing the corners.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "hideShiftedArrow",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "true",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, hides the arrow when it cannot be centered\nto the reference element.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "sticky",
    "type": "\"partial\" | \"always\"",
    "default": "\"partial\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The sticky behavior on the align axis. <code>partial</code> will keep the\ncontent in the boundary as long as the trigger is at least partially\nin the boundary whilst &amp;quot;always&amp;quot; will keep the content in the boundary\nregardless.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "hideWhenDetached",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Whether to hide the content when the trigger becomes fully occluded.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "positionStrategy",
    "type": "\"absolute\" | \"fixed\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The type of CSS position property to use.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "updatePositionStrategy",
    "type": "\"always\" | \"optimized\"",
    "default": "&#39;optimized&#39;",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Strategy to update the position of the floating element on every animation frame.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disableUpdateOnLayoutShift",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Whether to disable the update position for the content when the layout shifted.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "prioritizePosition",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Force content to be position within the viewport.</p>\n<p>Might overlap the reference element, which may not be desired.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "reference",
    "type": "ReferenceElement",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The custom element or virtual element that will be set as the reference\nto position the floating element.</p>\n<p>If provided, it will replace the default anchor element.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "dir",
    "type": "Direction",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The reading direction of the popper content when applicable. &amp;lt;br&amp;gt; If omitted, inherits globally from <code>ConfigProvider</code> or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "asChild",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.</p>\n<p>Read our <a href=\"https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/composition\">Composition</a> guide for more details.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "as",
    "type": "AsTag | Component",
    "default": "\"div\"",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by <code>asChild</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "disableOutsidePointerEvents",
    "type": "boolean",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>When <code>true</code>, hover/focus/click interactions will be disabled on elements outside\nthe <code>DismissableLayer</code>. Users will need to click twice on outside elements to\ninteract with them: once to close the <code>DismissableLayer</code>, and again to trigger the element.</p>"
  }
]' />
